summary: Tests-only run for issue #39. Committed: (1) SolverParityCorpusTests with a committed parity corpus fixture (7 hand-verified cases: Elixir doctest, three-way tie with earliest-wins, exclusions, zero-weight and weight-flip cases, all-excluded) asserting exact WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections at scorer level AND through the CompositionSolver fast path; (2) /api/v1 wire-contract tests in PaletteAPIClientTests (paths, printer_profile_id query, headers, 401/5xx/malformed mapping, envelope decode) that the generated OpenAPI client migration must keep green; (3) docs/parity-corpus.md (corpus location, schema, refresh procedure) and docs/issue-39-verification.md (criterion map, /api/v1 shape findings, parity findings). NOT EXECUTED: the container has no Swift toolchain (swift: command not found; bin/lint skips the build and exits 0). Corpus expectations were cross-validated against an independent re-implementation of the selection policy (all 7 cases consistent, tie bit-exact). Execute `cd ColorComposerCore && swift test` on a Swift host before merging the implementation.
